title: Export a schematic library to AutoCAD DXF
summary: Saves a schematic library under another name and format with SetFileName and DoFileSave, then restores it; shows that DoFileSave honours only the editor's SaveFilters, so a DXF export silently writes the native format.
phrasings: save a document in another format from code
why does DoFileSave ignore the format
export a symbol library to AutoCAD

commands.name: SchLibToDxf
commands.description: Attempt the AutoCAD DXF export of a schematic library and report what was written
commands.params: SchLibFileName=<path to .SchLib> (default: the focused schematic library)|DXFFileName=<path of the .dxf> (default: <Out>/<library name>.dxf)|Out=<folder> (default: temp folder)|Filter=<save format name> (default 'AutoCAD Files')
